Day 1 · Jun 5
JFK Terminal 4 + Shenzhen Bay skyline
Flight

JFK → Shenzhen

Outbound travel day

01
Morning
Sleep in, hydrate, and keep the day light. Confirm passport, China visa requirements, flight, SZX hotel address in Chinese, travel insurance, eSIM, Alipay/WeChat Pay, and a backup physical card.
Afternoon
Leave for JFK early enough to arrive about 3 hours before departure. Use the airline app to verify the connection terminal and baggage-through-checking.
Evening
Board the one-stop itinerary to Shenzhen. Set your phone to China time, eat lightly, and sleep during China nighttime.

Suggested hotel location

Hotel tonight: on the aircraft.

How to get around today

JFK: AirTrain from Jamaica or Howard Beach, rideshare, or car service. Use a single protected ticket through to SZX rather than separate tickets.

Day 2 · Jun 6
Shenzhen Bay and China Resources Headquarters
Shenzhen

Arrival + Shenzhen Bay

Gentle jet-lag reset

02
Morning / arrival
Land at Shenzhen Bao’an International Airport, clear immigration, collect bags, activate data, and withdraw a small cash backup.
Afternoon
Check in and nap for no more than 60–90 minutes. Walk around your hotel neighborhood and pick up water/snacks.
Evening
Shenzhen Bay Park promenade at sunset, followed by an easy Cantonese dinner. Skip any fixed-time attraction tonight.

Suggested hotel location

Stay in Futian CBD near Shopping Park/Civic Center for the easiest all-around transit, or Nanshan near Houhai for Shenzhen Bay access.

How to get around today

SZX → Futian: Metro Line 11 to Futian, then short taxi/metro connection. Futian → Shenzhen Bay Park: Metro to Shenzhen Bay Park station or a 15–25 minute DiDi depending on traffic.

Day 3 · Jun 7
Shenzhen

Futian skyline + Civic Center

Parks, architecture and city views

03
Morning
Lianhuashan Park before the heat. Walk to the hilltop Deng Xiaoping statue and overlook.
Afternoon
Civic Center area: Shenzhen Museum or the Museum of Contemporary Art & Planning Exhibition, then a long indoor lunch/coffee break.
Evening
Ping An Finance Center observation deck around golden hour, followed by dinner around COCO Park or UpperHills.

Suggested hotel location

Best base: Futian near Shopping Park, Convention & Exhibition Center, or Civic Center stations.

How to get around today

Hotel → Lianhuashan: Metro to Children’s Palace or Lianhuacun, then walk. Park → Civic Center: 15–25 minute walk downhill. Civic Center → Ping An: Metro to Shopping Park; walk through the underground mall network.

Day 4 · Jun 8
Shenzhen

Huaqiangbei + Dongmen

Electronics culture and old commercial streets

04
Morning
Book the Klook Huaqiangbei & Dongmen half-day private tour, or explore Huaqiangbei independently while shops are opening.
Afternoon
SEG Plaza/electronics markets, then transfer to Dongmen Pedestrian Street for local snacks and historic shopping lanes.
Evening
Return to Futian for a modern contrast: rooftop drink, massage, or relaxed dinner.

Suggested hotel location

Stay in Futian; it keeps the tour meeting point and evening options simple.

How to get around today

Metro to Huaqiang North or Huaqiang Road. Huaqiangbei → Dongmen: Metro to Laojie. Return to Futian via Line 1 toward Shopping Park/Convention & Exhibition Center.

Day 5 · Jun 9
Shenzhen

Dapeng Ancient City + coast

Added heritage day

05
Morning
Early DiDi/private-car departure to Dapeng Fortress. Walk the gates, ancestral halls, lanes and small museums before midday heat.
Afternoon
Continue to Jiaochangwei village/beach for lunch and a seaside walk. Keep swimming optional because June weather can be unsettled.
Evening
Return to central Shenzhen before rush hour. Pack for the next day’s train and have dinner near the hotel.

Suggested hotel location

Keep the same Futian hotel; changing bases for one night is not worth it.

How to get around today

Public transit is slow. Best: prebook a full-day car/driver or DiDi each way, roughly 1.5–2 hours depending on traffic. Ask the hotel to write 大鹏所城 and 较场尾 in Chinese.

Day 6 · Jun 10
Hangzhou

Bullet train to Hangzhou

Long rail leg + West Lake evening

06
Morning
Check out and reach Shenzhen North 60–75 minutes before departure. Take a direct G-train to Hangzhou East.
Afternoon
Arrive Hangzhou East, transfer to a West Lake hotel, check in, and rest.
Evening
Easy first look at West Lake: Hubin promenade, Broken Bridge area, or a short sunset boat ride if operating.

Suggested hotel location

Stay near Longxiangqiao/Hubin for walkability and metro access, or near Wulin Square for better value and transport.

How to get around today

Futian → Shenzhen North: Metro Line 4. Hangzhou East → Longxiangqiao: Metro Line 1. Longxiangqiao → Hubin/West Lake: 5–15 minute walk.

Day 7 · Jun 11
Lingyin Temple + Longjing tea village
Hangzhou

Lingyin Temple + tea village

Buddhist art and Longjing culture

07
Morning
Go early to Feilai Peak and Lingyin Temple. Allow 3–4 hours for grottoes, halls, incense courtyards and crowds.
Afternoon
Continue to Meijiawu or Longjing tea village for a tea-field walk, tasting and late lunch. A Klook full-day guide is useful here.
Evening
Return to West Lake for the illuminated promenade or the Impression West Lake performance if it is running in 2027.

Suggested hotel location

Best base: Hubin/Longxiangqiao. You can walk to the lake at night and still reach transit easily.

How to get around today

Hotel → Lingyin: taxi/DiDi is simplest (about 25–40 minutes with traffic); public buses also run but are slower. Lingyin → tea village: short taxi. Tea village → hotel: DiDi back to Hubin.

Day 8 · Jun 12
Hangzhou

West Lake full circuit

Classical landscape day

08
Morning
Start at Broken Bridge, stroll Bai Causeway, then visit Solitary Hill and the Zhejiang Provincial Museum area.
Afternoon
Boat across the lake, walk Su Causeway, then choose Leifeng Pagoda or Huagang Park. Do not attempt every landmark.
Evening
Dinner around Hefang Street/Southern Song Imperial Street, followed by a slow walk through restored lanes.

Suggested hotel location

Stay near Longxiangqiao/Hubin; this day is designed to begin on foot from the hotel.

How to get around today

Most lake sights connect by walking, sightseeing shuttle, boat and short taxis. Hubin → Hefang Street: Metro Line 1 to Ding’an Road or a 10–15 minute DiDi.

Day 9 · Jun 13
Shanghai

Train to Shanghai + Bund

Easy transfer and first skyline

09
Morning
Late breakfast, check out, and take a 45–60 minute high-speed train from Hangzhou East to Shanghai Hongqiao.
Afternoon
Check in around People’s Square, East Nanjing Road, or Jing’an. Walk East Nanjing Road toward the Bund.
Evening
Bund waterfront at blue hour. Optional Huangpu River cruise after dinner; book a flexible departure window.

Suggested hotel location

Best first-visit base: People’s Square/East Nanjing Road for maximum sightseeing convenience. Jing’an is calmer and more dining-focused.

How to get around today

Hangzhou hotel → Hangzhou East: Metro Line 1. Shanghai Hongqiao → People’s Square/East Nanjing Road: Metro Line 2. East Nanjing Road → Bund: 10–15 minute walk.

Day 10 · Jun 14
Shanghai

Old City + French Concession

Gardens, lanes and neighborhoods

10
Morning
Yu Garden and City God Temple area immediately after opening. Explore the classical garden before tour groups peak.
Afternoon
Taxi/metro to the Former French Concession: Wukang Road, Ferguson Lane, tree-lined streets and cafés.
Evening
Xintiandi or Tianzifang for dinner and evening atmosphere. Choose one, not both, to avoid rushing.

Suggested hotel location

Stay around People’s Square/East Nanjing Road or Jing’an; both connect easily to the day’s neighborhoods.

How to get around today

Hotel → Yu Garden: Metro Line 10/14 to Yuyuan Garden. Yu Garden → Wukang Road: taxi or Metro 10 to Shanghai Library. Wukang → Xintiandi: Metro 10 to Xintiandi or taxi.

Day 11 · Jun 15
Pudong skyline and modern architecture
Shanghai

Pudong modern architecture

Skyscrapers and museums

11
Morning
Lujiazui riverside promenade and one observation deck: Shanghai Tower is the strongest all-around choice.
Afternoon
Choose Shanghai Museum East, Pudong Art Museum, or a long indoor lunch break depending on exhibitions and weather.
Evening
Cross by ferry for skyline views, then dinner near the Bund or return to Lujiazui for a nighttime perspective.

Suggested hotel location

People’s Square/East Nanjing Road keeps both sides of the river accessible. Jing’an adds 10–15 minutes but better nightlife.

How to get around today

Metro Line 2 to Lujiazui. Walk between the Oriental Pearl, riverfront and Shanghai Tower area. For the ferry, use Dongchang Road ferry terminal and cross to Jinling East Road.

Day 12 · Jun 16
Shanghai

Zhujiajiao Water Town

Klook day trip

12
Morning
Join a Klook Zhujiajiao half-day/full-day tour, ideally with boat ride and an English-speaking guide.
Afternoon
Canals, Fangsheng Bridge, old lanes, snacks and a short wooden-boat ride. Return to central Shanghai around 16:00–18:00.
Evening
Acrobatics show, jazz bar, or a quiet dinner near the hotel depending on energy.

Suggested hotel location

Stay near People’s Square when taking a group tour; many pickups or meeting points are in the central city.

How to get around today

Follow the Klook meeting instructions. Independent route: Metro Line 17 to Zhujiajiao, then taxi/local bus or a 20–30 minute walk to the old town entrance.

Day 13 · Jun 17
Shanghai

Flexible culture day

Museum, food or Suzhou alternative

13
Morning
Shanghai Museum People’s Square or a guided food walk. Reserve museum entry when the 2027 system opens.
Afternoon
Choose M50 contemporary art district, Jewish Refugees Museum, or extra French Concession time.
Evening
Final Shanghai dinner and pack. Keep this evening light before the morning train.

Suggested hotel location

Stay near People’s Square or Jing’an. Both make the next morning’s trip to Hongqiao manageable.

How to get around today

People’s Square museum is directly on Lines 1/2/8. M50: taxi or Metro to Jiangning Road plus walk. Hongqiao station next morning: Line 2 or taxi with extra rush-hour time.

Day 14 · Jun 18
Fuxing train at Shanghai Hongqiao Station
Beijing

Bullet train to Beijing

Arrival + hutong evening

14
Morning
Early checkout and direct G-train from Shanghai Hongqiao to Beijing South. Arrive 45–60 minutes before departure.
Afternoon
Check in around Wangfujing/Dongdan or Qianmen. Rest, then walk a short section of the central city.
Evening
Shichahai lakes and hutongs, or Qianmen/Dashilar if staying south of the Forbidden City.

Suggested hotel location

Best first-visit base: Wangfujing/Dongdan for central access; Qianmen for atmosphere and Tiananmen proximity; Dongzhimen for airport convenience.

How to get around today

Shanghai hotel → Hongqiao: Metro Line 2 or taxi. Beijing South → Wangfujing/Dongdan: Metro Line 4, transfer to Lines 1/5; taxi is easier with luggage.

Day 15 · Jun 19
Beijing

Tiananmen + Forbidden City

Imperial Beijing

15
Morning
Timed Tiananmen/Forbidden City entry. Enter from the south and follow the central axis through the palace complex.
Afternoon
Exit north, climb Jingshan Park for the classic panorama, then rest at the hotel.
Evening
Wangfujing, National Centre for the Performing Arts exterior, or a small-group Beijing food tour.

Suggested hotel location

Stay Wangfujing/Dongdan or Qianmen. These minimize the earliest and most security-sensitive sightseeing day.

How to get around today

Use Metro Line 1 to Tiananmen East/West or walk from Qianmen. Forbidden City exit → Jingshan: 5–10 minute walk. Jingshan → hotel: taxi or local bus/metro connection.

Day 16 · Jun 20
Mutianyu section of the Great Wall
Beijing

Mutianyu Great Wall

Klook full-day tour

16
Morning
Early Klook tour departure for Mutianyu. Choose a package with round-trip transport and entry; add cable car/toboggan based on comfort.
Afternoon
Walk a manageable wall section, stop often for views, and return to Beijing late afternoon.
Evening
Simple dinner near the hotel, foot massage, and an early night.

Suggested hotel location

Stay central near Wangfujing/Qianmen or near a listed Klook pickup point. Verify pickup before finalizing the hotel.

How to get around today

Use the tour bus/private transfer. Independent public transit requires multiple steps and is not ideal for a first trip. Carry your passport and the exact tour voucher.

Day 17 · Jun 21
Beijing

Temple of Heaven + Summer Palace

Final full sightseeing day

17
Morning
Temple of Heaven Park soon after opening to see local exercise, music and the Hall of Prayer for Good Harvests.
Afternoon
Summer Palace: Long Corridor, Kunming Lake and Longevity Hill. Take a boat when operating to reduce walking.
Evening
Peking duck farewell dinner, then pack and confirm airport transfer.

Suggested hotel location

Stay in the same Wangfujing/Dongdan or Qianmen hotel.

How to get around today

Hotel → Temple of Heaven: Metro Line 5 to Tiantandongmen. Temple → Summer Palace: taxi saves time, or metro with transfers to Beigongmen/Xiyuan. Summer Palace → hotel: metro or DiDi after rush hour.

Day 18 · Jun 22
Flight

Beijing → JFK

Departure day

18
Morning
Breakfast, final neighborhood walk, hotel checkout and document check. Keep the schedule empty unless the flight is very late.
Afternoon
Leave for PEK or PKX about 4–5 hours before an international departure, allowing for traffic and terminal procedures.
Evening
Fly to JFK; arrival timing depends on routing and the international date line.

Suggested hotel location

No hotel unless the schedule requires an airport night.

How to get around today

To PEK: Airport Express from Dongzhimen or taxi. To PKX: Daxing Airport Express from Caoqiao or taxi. Confirm which Beijing airport before booking the final hotel transfer.

Suggested hotel locations

Shenzhen · Futian

Best all-around choice.

  • Near Shopping Park, Civic Center or Convention & Exhibition Center
  • Easy Line 4 access to Shenzhen North
  • Good restaurants and evening skyline access

Hangzhou · Hubin

Best for West Lake evenings.

  • Near Longxiangqiao station
  • Walk to lake promenade
  • Convenient for Hefang Street and Hangzhou East

Shanghai · People’s Square

Best first-trip convenience.

  • Lines 1, 2 and 8
  • Walk/metro to Bund and museums
  • Easy Line 2 to Hongqiao

Beijing · Wangfujing/Dongdan

Best central sightseeing base.

  • Close to Forbidden City
  • Lines 1 and 5 access
  • Simple dining and taxi pickup

Booking and navigation notes

Navigation: install Amap/Gaode or Apple Maps before departure. Save every hotel and attraction in Chinese. DiDi is best for complicated cross-city transfers; metro is best for predictable central-city travel.

Train tickets: Chinese rail tickets are passport-linked. Arrive 45–75 minutes early, use the station named on the ticket, and keep your passport accessible.
